build_maskformer_swin_config: build a MaskFormer config with Swin-L backbone for panoptic segmentation on COCO
configure_swin_backbone: configure a SwinTransformer backbone with embed_dims 192 and window_size 12
set_optimizer_hyperparams: set optimizer hyperparameters with lr 6e-5 and weight_decay 0.01 for MaskFormer training
configure_lr_scheduler: configure a linear warmup followed by multi-step learning rate scheduler for 300 epochs
define_panoptic_head: define a MaskFormer panoptic head with PixelDecoder and grouped normalization
